data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.subtitle: Lucidworks — San Francisco — Feb 2022 – Jul 2026
bullets: Developed SaaS and on-Prem Fusion Admin UI features using StencilJS, TypeScript, and SCSS, delivering a unified user experience across platforms and reducing UI inconsistencies
Built AI-powered search and recommendation UI components including configuration screens and result views, enabling faster configuration of AI features for end users

Enabled adoption of Claude Code and Claude Skills, authoring reusable prompt templates and reviewing AI-generated code before release, which cut component development time and improved code quality across the engineering team
Extended the frontend component library and design system across ten micro-frontend repositories, standardizing reusable components and improving UI consistency, which lowered maintenance effort

Leveraged deep knowledge of backend data models to partner with API engineers, refining API contracts to fully meet product requirements, resulting in smoother feature integration and fewer post-release bugs
Operated in a Kubernetes and Docker deployment environment on Google Cloud Platform, enabling reliable SaaS releases and reducing deployment incidents
Led the Fusion Admin UI roadmap and technical-debt management, applying first-principles thinking to prioritize and resolve a multi-year backlog, which streamlined releases and improved UI stability
Provided domain knowledge and technical direction across all frontend squads while owning a key product area, resulting in consistent implementation patterns and faster feature delivery

Led cross-team initiatives to standardize frontend architecture, frameworks, and best practices, enforcing code quality, PR review, and documentation standards, which increased code consistency and reduced review cycle time
Conducted technical interviews with hiring decisions instrumental in building nearly the entire frontend team
Collaborated with UX/UI designers using Figma to turn design intent into functional, production-ready features, and identified and closed multiple capability gaps, reducing feature delivery time
Completed Lucidworks' internal mentorship program as a mentee in 2024 and then mentored junior and senior frontend engineers which raised code quality and accelerated onboarding for new team members

data.title: UI Engineer
data.subtitle: Lucidworks — San Francisco — Nov 2017 – Feb 2022
bullets: Transitioned the UI codebase from AngularJS, JavaScript, and SCSS to StencilJS, TypeScript, and SCSS, introducing new architectural and state-management patterns that enabled framework-agnostic component reuse across the shared web component library, reducing duplication and speeding up new feature development

Owned the full frontend engineering lifecycle for the Fusion Admin UI, from concept through post-QE feedback, and contributed code to almost every shipped feature, which helped deliver releases on schedule and maintain consistent UI quality
Built a data-model mapping designer and a custom UI error-logging and observability service using TypeScript and Web Components, providing developers with clear error insights that cut debugging time
Implemented and maintained SonarQube quality-gate tooling in the frontend pipeline, ensuring code met quality standards and decreasing critical issues by improving early detection
Accelerated development across multiple SaaS projects by temporarily joining frontend teams, removing technical blockers, and delivering key features on schedule
Helped design and implement the organization's feature-flag governance model through an engineering process council, later adopted org-wide

Mentored junior frontend engineers across squads on code practices, Pull Request hygiene, and documentation, which improved code quality and reduced review cycle time by fostering consistent engineering processes
Collaborated closely with Product, Design, Backend, and Quality Engineering teams to align feature requirements and testing strategies, resulting in smoother releases and fewer integration issues
Flagged feature capability and design gaps and delivered actionable suggestions, helping the team address critical issues before development and improving overall product readiness
Documented, shared, and maintained technical guides for engineers using Markdown and internal wikis, which increased onboarding efficiency and reduced knowledge-transfer delays

data.title: UI Engineer (Contract)
data.subtitle: Lucidworks — Dubai (Remote) — Sep 2014 – Nov 2017
bullets: Developed Fusion Admin UI (v1.2+) using Angular 1.2+ and SCSS, enabling faster configuration of admin panels and reducing UI bugs

Led development of Query Workbench and Search UI, a reactive pipeline configuration tool that let engineers preview live query changes and compare results with production output, improving debugging efficiency and supporting faceting features
Built UI components for search-domain elements such as data sources, connectors, pipelines, and profiles, supporting ingestion, indexing, and querying workflows and streamlining user interactions
Integrated UI features with Fusion and Solr APIs using mocked data stores resulting in quicker delivery times and increased feature reliability

Advanced from following specs to defining frontend integration requirements and architecture decisions, bridging UI design and engineering and mentoring junior developers through structured mentorship

Collaborated with Product, Design, Core Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, using GitHub Actions, SonarQube, and Jenkins to set up automated unit and integration testing and code-style checks, which delivered higher-quality software faster

data.title: Intern & Engineer
data.subtitle: Honeywell Technology Solutions Lab — Bengaluru — Dec 2011 – Sep 2014
bullets: Developed the HTML5 proof-of-concept for a remote web server supporting a home-security system, using CSS and JavaScript; later adopted as the foundation for the subsequent Engineer role. Code was shipped to production in the EMEA region

Created an original in-house comic strip to illustrate process-improvement concepts and designed recognition cards that encouraged team members to apply the concepts, resulting in increased adoption of the new processes across the team
